title: Addendum to OpenAI o3 and o4-mini system card: OpenAI o3 Operator
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: We are replacing the existing GPT-4o-based model for Operator with a version based on OpenAI o3. The API version will remain based on 4o....
body:
We are replacing the existing GPT-4o-based model for Operator with a version based on OpenAI o3. The API version will remain based on 4o.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/o3-o4-mini-system-card-addendum-operator-o3).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
